lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits, with prominent local maxima aligned in roughly vertical and horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal alignment of spots, creating a visible lattice-like pattern on the shark's flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from a high-intensity light edge above to a shadowed gradient below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, circular orange-pigmented lesion or mark is located on the upper flank near the posterior end of the gill region. Additionally, two thin, linear white scars are visible diagonally across the mid-posterior flank.
other_distinctive_markers: The unique orange-colored circular marking on the anterior-dorsal region of the flank is a highly distinctive visual identifier.
